text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Today is the Hyacinth Stakes and my Umas are as precious as ever! ♪ But I've got this strange feeling they're even more dazzling than before…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's like beneath their grace lies something even more pristine. Oooh, I just have to see it! I'm going to get even closer than before!
